about_the_game: Push letters to form words in Spell Slide—a unique word game with two distinct modes. In Creative mode, discover as many words as you can to boost your score and unlock new levels. In Puzzle mode, each world introduces new mechanics: from bespoke single-solution challenges, to puzzles where spelling specific words opens doors, to strategy levels with companion robots, and even cryptic clue-based conundrums. Whether you're into freeform wordplay or structured problem-solving, Spell Slide lets you play your way.
